newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ciba says forex rates helped sales growth.
newsitem.headline: Ciba says forex rates helped sales growth.

text.p: Ciba Specialty Chemicals Inc reported a 19 percent rise in 1997 first quarter sales and said sales growth in Swiss francs was supported by favourable exchange rates.
"Sales growth in Swiss francs was supported by favourable exchange rates. Strong volume growth was tempered to some extent by price adjustments in several markets," Ciba SC said.

Sales for the quarter totalled 1.9 billion francs ($1.3 billion) as compared to 1.6 billion in the prior-year period. sales increased by four percent in local currencies, Ciba's first quarter statement said.
It said all divisions contributed to the increase in Swiss franc terms.
Sales in its additives division were up 13 percent in Swiss francs. Stable sales in local markets mask a strong volume increase of eight percent which was offset by reduced sales prices, Ciba said.
It said consumer cares sales were up 23 percent in Swiss francs and eight percent in local currencies with all business units contributing to the sales growth.
Antimircobial sales grew at a particularly strong pace and the whiteners business developed well. Overall sales growth in Latin America and the Asia/pacific region was "robust", it added.

Polymers were up 22 percent and five percent respectively, Pigments 20 percent and six percent and Textile Dyes 22 percent and eight percent. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340 ($ = 1.421 Swiss Francs)
